raw_text: Mandate bug on HDFC: Started SIP 6 months ago after seeing youtube videos on compounding. Today my portfolio is in RED. Invested Rs 18,000, current value is 17,400. Decided to pause SIP until market recovers. Please update the iOS app.
My mandate got rejected because bank name had small spelling difference. Groww didn't notify me in time, now my first SIP failed. Bad start for beginner. Apple Pay / UPI mandate failed.
Clean UI but critical flow issue: App is great for starting, but after 8 months there is zero motivation to continue. You just stare at a static chart. Stopped my SIP last week.
iOS user review: Honestly haven't opened the app in 4 months. Just seeing Rs 2000 getting debited every month on my bank SMS. It feels like an unwanted subscription now. Thinking of stopping it.
My uncle told me market is at all-time high of 25000 and crash is coming. He advised me to stop my equity SIP and put money in post office RD. So I stopped my Groww SIP.

Clean UI but critical flow issue: I work on freelance contracts and don't get paid on exact date. Groww has fixed debit dates (5th, 10th, 15th). When payment was delayed I had to frantically cancel SIP to avoid bank penalty.

Mandate bug on HDFC: Honestly haven't opened the app in 4 months. Just seeing Rs 2000 getting debited every month on my bank SMS. It feels like an unwanted subscription now. Thinking of stopping it. Apple Pay / UPI mandate failed.

iOS user review: Started SIP in January with high enthusiasm. By month 7 it feels completely detached. No progress updates, no milestones like 'congrats you completed 6 months', just silent debits. Cancelled.

iPhone app feedback: I work on freelance contracts and don't get paid on exact date. Groww has fixed debit dates (5th, 10th, 15th). When payment was delayed I had to frantically cancel SIP to avoid bank penalty. Uninstalled.

Clean UI but critical flow issue: Worst experience with autopay! My salary comes on 7th, SIP debit was set on 5th. Bank charged me Rs 500 NACH bounce fee! Why can't Groww check balance or let me postpone by 2 days without penalty? Cancelling my SIP.
Version 14.2 review: Invested in ELSS fund for 8 months. Wanted to withdraw Rs 5000 for emergency, but it says locked for 3 years! Nobody told me this upfront when starting SIP. Feeling cheated.

Mandate bug on HDFC: My units increased but NAV decreased so portfolio value dropped. I thought SIP means buying more when market falls? The dashboard doesn't show rupee cost averaging clearly at all. Ticket #2294.

iPhone app feedback: Started SIP without any plan, just because colleagues were doing it. After 6 months accumulated Rs 30,000. Withdrew full amount to buy new iPhone 16 during sale and stopped SIP. Please update the iOS app.
Saw on news that US fed rate and war will crash Nifty. Panicked and stopped my 500/month SIP. Don't want to lose my savings as I am a student. Uninstalled.
